title_en: The Boy Who Cried Wolf - With Background Music
source_file: 狼来了-带背景音乐（4-6 岁）.pptx
page_text_ocr_zh: 狼来了
page_text_en: The wolf is coming!
summary_zh: 画面中，一个牧童在田野里大喊‘狼来了’，旁边有一只狼和一只惊慌的羊，背景是绿色的田野和房屋。

title_en: The Boy Who Cried Wolf - With Background Music
source_file: 狼来了-带背景音乐（4-6 岁）.pptx
page_text_ocr_zh: 从前，有一个爱说谎，喜欢捉弄人的放羊娃。他每天都去山上放羊。
page_text_en: Once upon a time, there was a shepherd boy who loved to lie and play tricks on people. He went to the mountain every day to tend his sheep.
summary_zh: 本页介绍了故事的主角——一个爱说谎、喜欢捉弄人的放羊娃，并说明他每天去山上放羊。

title_en: The Boy Who Cried Wolf - With Background Music
source_file: 狼来了-带背景音乐（4-6 岁）.pptx
page_text_ocr_zh: 这天，他躺在大树下，心想：哎呀，真没意思，有没有什么好玩儿的事儿呢？
page_text_en: That day, he lay under a big tree, thinking: Oh, how boring. Is there anything fun to do?
summary_zh: 牧童躺在大树下，觉得无聊，心想有没有什么好玩的事儿。

title_en: The Boy Who Cried Wolf - With Background Music
source_file: 狼来了-带背景音乐（4-6 岁）.pptx
page_text_ocr_zh: 他一下子想出了一个寻开心的主意。
page_text_en: He suddenly came up with an idea to have some fun.
summary_zh: 牧童想到一个寻开心的主意，脸上露出狡黠的笑容，双手张开，似乎准备实施他的计划。

title_en: The Boy Who Cried Wolf - With Background Music
source_file: 狼来了-带背景音乐（4-6 岁）.pptx
page_text_ocr_zh: 他对山下大喊：狼来啦！狼来啦！
page_text_en: He shouted down the hill: Wolf is coming! Wolf is coming!
summary_zh: 牧童对着山下大喊‘狼来啦！狼来啦！’，画面中他张大嘴巴，似乎在模仿狼叫，旁边有一只狐狸从树后探出头来。

title_en: The Boy Who Cried Wolf - With Background Music
source_file: 狼来了-带背景音乐（4-6 岁）.pptx
page_text_ocr_zh: 村里的人们听到喊声，急忙拿着锄头和镰刀跑上山来。
page_text_en: The villagers heard the shout and hurried up the mountain, holding hoes and sickles.
summary_zh: 村民们听到牧童的喊声，急忙拿着农具跑上山来查看情况。

title_en: The Boy Who Cried Wolf - With Background Music
source_file: 狼来了-带背景音乐（4-6 岁）.pptx
page_text_ocr_zh: 人们一边跑一边焦急地问：狼真的来了啊？快看看狼在哪里！
page_text_en: People ran while anxiously asking: Has the wolf really come? Hurry, look and see where the wolf is!
summary_zh: 村民们听到牧童的呼喊后急忙跑上山，一边跑一边焦急地询问狼在哪里，但并未发现狼的踪迹。

title_en: The Boy Who Cried Wolf - With Background Music
source_file: 狼来了-带背景音乐（4-6 岁）.pptx
page_text_ocr_zh: 放羊娃哈哈地大笑起来：有什么大惊小怪的，你们都上当啦！
page_text_en: The shepherd boy burst into laughter: 'What's all the fuss about? You've all been tricked!'
summary_zh: 放羊娃看到村民赶来后大笑，嘲笑他们上当受骗，而村民则一脸困惑和愤怒。

title_en: The Boy Who Cried Wolf - With Background Music
source_file: 狼来了-带背景音乐（4-6 岁）.pptx
page_text_ocr_zh: 村里的人们很生气：这孩子真坏！怎么能开这种玩笑！
page_text_en: The villagers were very angry: This child is so bad! How could he play such a joke!
summary_zh: 村民们发现被牧童欺骗后非常生气，指责他不该开这种玩笑。

title_en: The Boy Who Cried Wolf - With Background Music
source_file: 狼来了-带背景音乐（4-6 岁）.pptx
page_text_ocr_zh: 这孩子真是太可气了！我们快回去吧。大家都生气地离开了。
page_text_en: This kid is really too annoying! Let's go back quickly. Everyone left angrily.
summary_zh: 村民们发现被牧童欺骗后非常生气，决定离开，并责备他不该开这种玩笑。

title_en: The Boy Who Cried Wolf - With Background Music
source_file: 狼来了-带背景音乐（4-6 岁）.pptx
page_text_ocr_zh: 放羊娃看到村民们被戏弄了，觉得很有意思！
page_text_en: The shepherd boy saw the villagers being tricked and found it very amusing!
summary_zh: 放羊娃看到村民们被他戏弄后感到非常有趣，脸上露出得意的笑容。

title_en: The Boy Who Cried Wolf - With Background Music
source_file: 狼来了-带背景音乐（4-6 岁）.pptx
page_text_ocr_zh: 于是，几天以后，他又故伎重演了！
page_text_en: So, a few days later, he did it again!
summary_zh: 牧童再次假装狼来了，脸上带着得意的笑容，背景是宁静的村庄和田野。

title_en: The Boy Who Cried Wolf - With Background Music
source_file: 狼来了-带背景音乐（4-6 岁）.pptx
page_text_ocr_zh: 狼来啦！好大的狼啊！狼来啦！
page_text_en: Wolf is coming! Such a big wolf! Wolf is coming!
summary_zh: 牧童再次大喊‘狼来啦！’，表情夸张，双手张开，似乎在继续捉弄村民。

title_en: The Boy Who Cried Wolf - With Background Music
source_file: 狼来了-带背景音乐（4-6 岁）.pptx
page_text_ocr_zh: 善良的村民们又冲上山来帮他打狼！
page_text_en: The kind villagers rushed up the mountain again to help him fight the wolf!
summary_zh: 村民们再次听到牧童的呼喊，拿着农具冲上山来帮忙打狼，表情愤怒而焦急。

title_en: The Boy Who Cried Wolf - With Background Music
source_file: 狼来了-带背景音乐（4-6 岁）.pptx
page_text_ocr_zh: 哈哈哈哈！你们又上当啦！
page_text_en: Hahaha! You fell for it again!
summary_zh: 牧童再次骗村民上山，村民们愤怒地赶来，却发现没有狼，牧童大笑嘲讽他们又上当了。

title_en: The Boy Who Cried Wolf - With Background Music
source_file: 狼来了-带背景音乐（4-6 岁）.pptx
page_text_ocr_zh: 村民气愤地指着放羊娃说：你这个坏孩子！看谁以后还信你的话！
page_text_en: The villager angrily pointed at the shepherd boy and said: You naughty child! See who will believe you in the future!
summary_zh: 村民愤怒地指责放羊娃，表示以后不会再相信他的话，放羊娃则露出得意又狡黠的表情。

title_en: The Boy Who Cried Wolf - With Background Music
source_file: 狼来了-带背景音乐（4-6 岁）.pptx
page_text_ocr_zh: 大伙儿对放羊娃一次又一次地说谎戏弄人非常气愤！都说：我们快走吧！
page_text_en: Everyone was very angry with the shepherd boy for lying and tricking them again and again! They all said: Let's go quickly!
summary_zh: 村民们对牧童反复撒谎感到愤怒，决定不再理会他，纷纷转身离开。

title_en: The Boy Who Cried Wolf - With Background Music
source_file: 狼来了-带背景音乐（4-6 岁）.pptx
page_text_ocr_zh: 过了几天，狼真的来了！
page_text_en: A few days later, the wolf really came!
summary_zh: 几天后，一只狼真的出现在羊群附近的山崖上，羊群显得惊慌，预示着危机的到来。

title_en: The Boy Who Cried Wolf - With Background Music
source_file: 狼来了-带背景音乐（4-6 岁）.pptx
page_text_ocr_zh: 放羊娃大喊：救命啊！救命！狼来啦！狼！狼真的来啦！
page_text_en: The shepherd boy shouts: Help! Help! The wolf is coming! Wolf! The wolf is really here!
summary_zh: 放羊娃惊恐地大喊救命，声称狼真的来了，表情极度恐慌，背景是晴朗的天空和绿色的田野。

title_en: The Boy Who Cried Wolf - With Background Music
source_file: 狼来了-带背景音乐（4-6 岁）.pptx
page_text_ocr_zh: 山下的村民听到放羊娃的喊声，认为他又在说谎骗人，都不理睬他。
page_text_en: The villagers below heard the shepherd boy's cry and thought he was lying again, so they ignored him.
summary_zh: 山下的村民听到放羊娃的呼救后，因之前被多次欺骗而选择不理睬他，继续悠闲地喝茶休息。

title_en: The Boy Who Cried Wolf - With Background Music
source_file: 狼来了-带背景音乐（4-6 岁）.pptx
page_text_ocr_zh: 没有人帮助放羊娃打狼。结果他的羊都被狼给咬死了！
page_text_en: No one helped the shepherd boy fight the wolf. As a result, all his sheep were bitten and killed by the wolf!
summary_zh: 由于村民不再相信放羊娃，当狼真的出现时无人相助，导致他的羊群被狼咬死。

title_en: The Boy Who Cried Wolf - With Background Music
source_file: 狼来了-带背景音乐（4-6 岁）.pptx
page_text_ocr_zh: 放羊娃难过地大哭：呜呜！呜呜！我可怜的羊！他以后再也不敢撒谎骗人了。
page_text_en: The shepherd boy cried sadly: 'Woo! Woo! My poor sheep! From now on, I will never lie to anyone again.'
summary_zh: 放羊娃因羊群被狼咬死而伤心大哭，意识到自己撒谎的后果，发誓再也不欺骗别人。
